title: Harbor pier — trim the tells
source_passage: Marla walked to the end of the pier and looked at the water. Marla counted the gulls wheeling over the masts. Marla felt terrified of what the tide would bring. The lamp at the harbor office was still lit. The harbor was a wound in the coastline that bled ships into the grey and hungry infinite. In the end, it all came down to this.
user_context: Can you tighten this a little? It feels repetitive and a bit overwritten. Keep the gull line exactly as it is — I love it.
